blocks.orig: The Rufiji River Camp lies beautifully on a riverbank of the Rufiji River in Julius Nyerere National Park. With 11 luxury double tents under thatched roofs and 3 tented suites with two tents each for families, it offers true relaxation in the middle of the jungle. Tents are spacious with wooden floors, beautiful bathrooms and large terraces with views over the nearby river. The shaded pool is a great way to cool off after an active day and the restaurant and bar overlook the river and allow for al fresco dining under the stars.
blocks.html: On the bank of the Rufiji River in Julius Nyerere National Park, The Rufiji River Camp enjoys a beautiful setting. It has 11 luxury double tents beneath thatched roofs and 3 tented suites for families, each with two tents, so you can truly unwind in the middle of the jungle. The tents are roomy, with wooden floors, lovely bathrooms and big terraces looking out over the river close by. After a busy day you can cool down in the shaded pool, and the restaurant and bar overlook the river, with the option of dining outdoors beneath the stars.
